_doc: M1911 attachments at the Armorer's Bench (UPDATE_04 section 6, DECISIONS T-068; docs/gravelight/WEAPONS.md section 25). Read by gravelight/weapons/m1911_kit.gd. Five slots, one option per slot (buying another option in a slot replaces the one there). Prices in Scrip. 'stats' multiply WeaponInstance.f(<key>) (so they stack with the Crucible tiers); 'set' replaces the magazine / reserve size; 'limb' multiplies a hitbox multiplier; 'recoil' multiplies the resolved recoil pattern; 'feel' overrides the viewmodel feel; 'draw' multiplies the raise time after a swap; 'props' are flags the weapon code reads (suppressed, kit_slow, kit_flare). Every option has an 'upgraded' block used on Last Rites (m1911_up): its own name and numbers, replacing the base block's.

extended.name: Extended Mag
extended.desc: A longer twelve-round box that sticks out of the grip. More rounds before the reload.

upgraded.name: Penitent's Magazine
upgraded.desc: Eighteen rounds of Last Rites, every one of them sorry.

drum.name: Drum Mag
drum.desc: A thirty-round drum hung under the grip. Heavy: a slower reload and a slower aim.

upgraded.name: Rosary Drum
upgraded.desc: Forty beads on the string, and every one of them a prayer.

match.name: Match Barrel
match.desc: A hand-fitted target barrel and bushing. Hits harder and carries further.

upgraded.name: Vesper Match
upgraded.desc: Fitted by candlelight. It reaches the back row, and one past it.

compensator.name: Compensator
compensator.desc: A ported muzzle brake. Recoil down 40%, and the next shot comes sooner.

upgraded.name: Censer Compensator
upgraded.desc: The ports throw a Nachtglas flare. Anything it touches at close range catches fire.

suppressor.name: Suppressor
suppressor.desc: EXPERIMENTAL. An OSS trials "can", stencilled and numbered, never issued. Quiet: your shots don't show on the map. -10% damage.

upgraded.name: Vow of Silence
upgraded.desc: The can has taken its vows. Still off the map, no damage lost, and +15% on a headshot.

radium.name: Radium Night Sights
radium.desc: Three radium dots, painted by hand. They glow in the dark and come up faster.

upgraded.name: Vigil Sights
upgraded.desc: The dots burn violet now, and they never close their eyes.

raised_target.name: Raised Target Sight
raised_target.desc: A tall, adjustable target rear and a high blade. A finer sight picture: tighter shots aimed.

upgraded.name: Steeple Sight
upgraded.desc: Tall as a church spire and just as patient.

stock.name: Detachable Shoulder Stock
stock.desc: A walnut board stock that clips to the heel of the grip. Rifle-steady: ADS sway -60%, less kick. A little slower to draw.

upgraded.name: Pallbearer Stock
upgraded.desc: It carries the weight so you don't have to.

checkered.name: Checkered Grips
checkered.desc: Deep-cut checkered panels and a stippled front strap. Steadier from the hip, and out of the holster faster.

upgraded.name: Confessor's Grips
upgraded.desc: Your hand knows what it's done. It holds on anyway.

hollow_points.name: Hollow-Points
hollow_points.desc: .45 ACP hollow-points from a private box. Headshots hit a lot harder.

upgraded.name: Last Word Hollow-Points
upgraded.desc: Every round has the last word, and the word is final.

nachtglas.name: Nachtglas-Tipped
nachtglas.desc: Sold under the counter. Violet glass in every nose: +20% damage, and now and then a hit slows the target.
nachtglas.locked_text: Under the counter. Come back when the lights are on.

upgraded.name: Nachtglas Benediction
upgraded.desc: The glass has been blessed. It is not sure by whom.

stat_bars._doc: The bench's six bars, each 0..1: damage (per shot) / damage_max; range (falloff end) / range_max; recoil (vertical kick x punch, relative to the plain M1911: lower is better); ADS speed ads_speed_ref / ads time; mobility (move speed / sqrt(draw)) / mobility_max; capacity mag / capacity_max.

finishes._doc: Cosmetic pistol finishes unlocked by lifetime M1911 kills (Last Rites kills count, as for weapon mastery). Chosen in Settings > Gameplay; ProfileSave.profile.equipped.m1911_finish. Last Rites always shows the Crucible's Nachtglas instead.

loadout_pick._doc: One attachment installed on your starting M1911 every match (cheap and never pay-to-win: Extended Mag or Checkered Grips only). Unlocked by lifetime M1911 kills; ProfileSave.profile.equipped.m1911_pick = 'mag:extended' / 'grip:checkered' / ''.
